problem_type: Persisted preview locator missing from transport DTO
symptom: Generated video plays but its asset-library thumbnail fails to load in web
direct_cause: List DTO spreads thumbnailRelativePath without thumbnailUrl; renderer derives nomi-local after HTTP transport translation
class_root: Persisted local preview paths must become canonical preview URLs at the asset DTO owner before platform transport
affected_population: Generated and imported image/video previews listed after persistence or restart
internal_only_reason: Internal persisted sidecar and canonical media transport contract; no external dependency controls URL derivation
invariants: Every listed stored preview has an owning canonical thumbnailUrl before platform translation
Listing reuses persisted preview metadata without encoding or rewriting source assets

door_reduction.why_not: Existing import/cached preview DTO creation and persisted asset listing are separate lifecycle entrances; both now converge on one derivation owner. No caller-specific derivation remains in list output.

generality_proof: Import and asset listing reuse the same preview DTO derivation; existing recursive web media translation converts both primary and thumbnail URLs, including legacy sidecars that persist only a relative path

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Derive canonical preview URL from project-owned persisted preview path

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Sidecar image/video records now reuse preview DTO owner before returning to desktop or web transport
Both newly generated and cached import previews already converge on withPreviewFields

recurrence.reason: Every persisted sidecar with relative preview path but no transient URL reproduces this on web listing
same_class_scan: door-map withPreviewFields found existing cached/new preview branches
door-map listProjectAssets found desktop IPC, spend references, asset identity and timeline readers; web/rpc.ts binds same owner
rg thumbnailRelativePath/thumbnailUrl traced useAllProjectAssets fallback after web/mediaUrls translation

prevention.invariant: Persisted preview metadata receives canonical URL before transport
prevention.failure_mode: Absent preview remains absent; existing asset read/transport ownership and path guards remain unchanged
prevention.strategy: Reuse the existing DTO derivation for list output instead of creating a browser-specific preview fallback

legacy_paths.rationale: Existing preview and media transport owners are reused; renderer fallback remains necessary for other non-stored asset DTOs

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application-owned DTO derivation; encoding and browser transport libraries do not change

migration: No disk migration: relative-path-only sidecars derive current project URLs on every list read
residual_risks: Actual generated-video thumbnail browser verification belongs to coordinator
